subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: What user-visible contract should context-overflow errors use for session identity and token-count certainty?
rationale: The code has enough diagnostic facts to implement richer messages, but repository evidence does not determine whether session identity may be disclosed or how estimated and observed counts should be presented.

options.title: Safe label and certainty
options.body: Show a redacted channel/session display label, provider/model, effective budget, and token values explicitly marked observed or estimated.

options.title: Model and budget only
options.body: Show provider/model and effective budget while omitting session identity and current-token values.

options.title: Keep details internal
options.body: Retain generic user guidance and expose detailed diagnostics only through logs and status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Safe label and certainty
recommendation.body: Show a redacted channel/session display label, provider/model, effective budget, and token values explicitly marked observed or estimated.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history spans the runner, shared error formatting, and auto-reply delivery surfaces that need one product contract.
